job.value: See which promos they have and when they expire

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'My promos' with a grid of voucher cards ('Waived platform fee', 'Enjoy 35% off') is clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: There's no action on any card ('Use', 'Shop now'), so it's unclear how to redeem 'Waived platform fee — For any purchase from therefurb'.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Filter by category' is clear, but the cards give no hint whether tapping them does anything.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Waived platform fee', 'PayLater by Grab' and 'Ends in 3 days' are plain.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Each card is two lines plus an expiry.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: All content is the person's promos.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Bold voucher titles and expiry lines carry it.
